 Predictions and form stats 
 Here are the Predictions for YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026, 71st Match (Super 8) - Boland vs Lions and 72nd Match (Super 8) - Titans vs Warriors, to be played on the 11th of November at the Boland Park, Paarl and LC de Villiers Oval, Pretoria.
 Match Prediction - Rocks v Lions 
 LIVE SCORES - 71st Match (Super 8) - Boland vs Lions (Boland Park, Paarl) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Boland Park, Paarl (CSA T20 Challenge) - 155
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Boland Park, Paarl (CSA T20 Challenge) - 154
 Current Form Boland:
 In the Super 8's, Boland are currently placed at the 3rd position with 4 wins and 2 losses to their credit. They have 16 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.112.
 The top run scorer for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Gavin Kaplan with 357 runs to his name .
 The top wicket taker for Boland in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Glenton Stuurman with 12 scalps under his belt.
 Boland have lost their previous match against South Western Districts by 19 runs.
 South Western Districts batted first and they posted a total of 169 for 5 in 20 overs. Yaseen Vallie got out without troubling the scorers much. After his dismissal, Janneman Malan and Slade Van Staden played to their potential, scoring 45 and 77 runs respectively. Staden hit 7 fours and 3 sixes during his knock of 77. On the back of these two knocks, South Western Districts managed to reach 169 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Boland couldn't get off to an ideal start and they were reduced to 31 for 2 in the 4th over itself. Gavin Kaplan and Gysbert Wege revived the innings with a stand of 71 runs for the 3rd wicket. Wege made 57 while Kaplan scored 42 runs. Once these two got out though, wickets started to fall in regular succession and Boland fell out of favor in the game. They couldn't play freely in the death overs and eventually fell short by 19 runs.
 Current Form Lions: 
 In the Super 8's, Lions are currently placed at the 2nd position with 4 wins, 1 loss and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 19 points to their name. Their NRR is 0.775.
 The top run scorer for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Connor Esterhuizen with 279 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lions in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Codi Yusuf with 11 scalps under his belt .
 Lions have lost their previous match against Western Province by 9 runs.
 Western Province batted first and they posted a total of 178 for 9 in 20 overs. Jiveshan Pillay got out after scoring 12 runs while Kashief Joseph and Kyle Verreynne played to their potential, scoring 55 and 46 runs respectively. The rest of the batting order collapsed as Gerald Coetzee bowled with a lot of fire and accuracy. He picked up 3 wickets for only 24 runs and Western Province had to settle for a total of 178, even though at one point, they were aiming at 190+.
 During the chase, openers Neil Trimmers and Onkgomoditse Seletswane started off very well. They collected 55 runs for the 1st wicket partnership and laid down hopes for a successful chase. Trimmers made 23 runs before being dismissed. Rassie van der Dussen and Mitchell van Buuren failed terribly and couldn't really trouble the scorers much. Onkgomoditse Seletswane fought hard and scored 72 runs off 47 deliveries but he barely got any support from the other batters. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Lions never really got going in death overs. Josh Breed bowled really well. He picked up 2 wickets for 31 runs and helped restrict Lions to 169 for 6 in 20 overs and Western Province won the game by 9 runs.

 Match Prediction - Titans (SA) v Warriors (SA) 
 LIVE SCORES - 72nd Match (Super 8) - Titans vs Warriors (LC de Villiers Oval, Pretoria) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at LC de Villiers Oval, Pretoria (CSA T20 Challenge) - 151
 Average 2nd Innings Total at LC de Villiers Oval, Pretoria (CSA T20 Challenge) - 155
 Current Form Warriors:
 In the Super 8's, Warriors are currently placed at the 1st position with 4 wins, 1 loss and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 20 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.818.
 The top run scorer for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Jordan Herman with 238 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Warriors in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Thomas Kaber with 15 scalps under his belt .
 Warriors have won their previous match against Eastern Storm by 20 runs.
 Warriors batted first and they posted a total of 206 for 4 in 20 overs. Jordan Hermann and Sibonelo Makhanya played really well at the top. Hermann made 33 off 28 balls while Makhanya scored 74 runs in only 42 deliveries, hitting 5 fours and 6 sixes. Tristan Stubbs also played to his potential and smashed 48 runs in only 19 balls, collecting 2 fours and 5 sixes. He stayed not out and helped Warriors get to a tall total of 206 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Eastern Storm lost the key wicket of Kabelo Sekhukhune quite early. After his dismissal, Ronan Hermann and Christopher Britz played quite well. They scored 56 and 63 runs respectively. However, once these two got out, Eastern Storm went down the spiral. The middle and lower order batters failed terribly and Eastern Storm were eventually restricted to 186 for 7 in 20 overs, losing the match by 20 runs.
 Current Form Titans: 
 In the Super 8's, Titans are currently placed at the 6th position with 2 wins, 3 losses and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 12 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.250.
 The top run scorer for Titans in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Lhuan-dre Pretorius with 453 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Titans in the YesPlay Pro20 Cup 2026 is Tabraiz Shamsi with 11 scalps under his belt .
 The previous match of Titans against Dolphins was cancelled due to rain. However, in their last outing, Titans lost against Lions by 15 runs.
 Lions batted first and they posted a total of 206 for 3 in 20 overs. Zubayr Hamza and Neil Trimmers got out without troubling the scorers much. After their dismissals, Rassie van der Dussen and Connor Esterhuizen played really well, scoring 37 and 98 runs respectively. Connor Esterhuizen hit 8 fours and 6 sixes during his knock of 98 runs in only 50 balls. Mitchell van Buuren also contributed healthily with a quickfire 39 off 22 deliveries as Lions managed to get to a tall total of 201 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Lhuan-dre Pretorius and Rivaldo Moonsamy got their team off to a great start. They collected 65 quick runs within the Powerplay overs for the 1st wicket. Once Lhuan-dre Pretorius got out, the scoring rate slowed down considerably. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Titans could never really pick the pace up. Siya Plaatjie and Peter picked up 2 wickets each to help restrict Titans to 191 for 7 in 20 overs, as Lions lost the game by 15 runs.
